name: HDB Existing Building — reduced visualization demo

metadata.source: HDB Existing Building — data.gov.sg (Housing & Development Board)
metadata.input_crs_assumption: WGS 84 longitude/latitude (RFC 7946; EPSG:4326 x/y for transformation); input has no crs member
metadata.measurement_note: Footprint geometry is sourced; render_height_m is a visualization-only default and is not an official height.

demo_area.label: Data-derived HDB demo area (not a selected BTO development)
demo_area.selection_rule: footprint intersects a circular buffer in EPSG:3414 (SVY21 metres)
